```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(jsonlite)

fig3_dir <- "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/CARDIAC-FM/figure_numbers_new/fig3_external_zeroshot"
fig5_dir <- "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/CARDIAC-FM/figure_numbers_new/fig5_fewshot"

auroc_json <- file.path(fig5_dir, "fig5_stats.json")

# fig5_stats.json currently stores one metric as pt/ci. Use it as AUROC.
# If an AUPRC stats JSON is available later with the same structure, set this path.
auprc_json <- file.path(fig5_dir, "fig5_auprc_stats.json")
requested_metrics <- c("auroc", "auprc")

out_dir <- file.path(fig3_dir, "fig5_all_metric_plots")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

model_order <- c(
  "ECG-FM",
  "ECGFounder",
  "DeepECG-SSL",
  "DeepECG-SL",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG)"
)

model_colors <- c(
  "ECG-FM" = "#7A869A",
  "ECGFounder" = "#0072B2",
  "DeepECG-SSL" = "#D55E00",
  "DeepECG-SL" = "#CC79A7",
  "CARDIAC-FM (ECG)" = "#009E73"
)

outcome_labels <- c(
  mi10 = "Myocardial Infarction",
  is10 = "Ischemic Stroke",
  cvddth10 = "CV Death",
  dth10 = "All-cause Death"
)

fewshot_labels <- c(
  train_valid_5_5 = "10% Few-shot",
  train_valid_10_10 = "20% Few-shot"
)

symbol_map <- c(
  "ECG-FM" = "*",
  "ECGFounder" = "\u2020",
  "DeepECG-SSL" = "\u2021",
  "DeepECG-SL" = "\u00A7"
)

caption_text <- paste0(
  "Marks on CARDIAC-FM bars indicate baselines significantly outperformed by CARDIAC-FM ",
  "(paired bootstrap p<0.05): * ECG-FM   \u2020 ECGFounder   ",
  "\u2021 DeepECG-SSL   \u00A7 DeepECG-SL"
)
```

```{r}
parse_fig5_json <- function(json_file, metric_name) {
  if (!file.exists(json_file)) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  fig_json <- fromJSON(json_file, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  rows <- list()

  for (key in names(fig_json)) {
    if (startsWith(key, "_")) next

    key_parts <- str_split_fixed(key, "\\|", 2)
    dataset_i <- key_parts[, 1]
    split_i <- key_parts[, 2]
    fewshot_i <- unname(fewshot_labels[split_i])

    for (entry in fig_json[[key]]) {
      outcome_i <- entry$o
      outcome_display_i <- unname(outcome_labels[outcome_i])
      marks_i <- entry$marks %||% ""

      for (model_i in names(entry$pt)) {
        ci_i <- entry$ci[[model_i]]

        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
          dataset = dataset_i,
          split = split_i,
          fewshot = fewshot_i,
          outcome = outcome_i,
          outcome_display = outcome_display_i,
          metric = metric_name,
          model = model_i,
          value = entry$pt[[model_i]],
          ci_lo = ci_i[[1]],
          ci_hi = ci_i[[2]],
          npos = entry$npos,
          nn = entry$nn,
          sig_label = ifelse(model_i == "CARDIAC-FM (ECG)", marks_i, "")
        )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(rows)
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x)) y else x
}

metrics <- bind_rows(
  parse_fig5_json(auroc_json, "auroc"),
  parse_fig5_json(auprc_json, "auprc")
) %>%
  mutate(
    fewshot = factor(fewshot, levels = c("10% Few-shot", "20% Few-shot")),
    outcome_display = factor(outcome_display, levels = unname(outcome_labels)),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("auroc", "auprc")),
    model = factor(model, levels = model_order)
  )

if (nrow(metrics) == 0) {
  stop("No Fig 5 metric data found.")
}

available_metrics <- sort(unique(as.character(metrics$metric)))
missing_metrics <- setdiff(requested_metrics, available_metrics)

write_csv(metrics, file.path(out_dir, "fig5_all_metrics_long.csv"))
```

      paste(toupper(missing_metrics), collapse = ", "),

      "To generate AUPRC panels, provide an AUPRC JSON with the same structure and set auprc_json.\n"

```{r}
plot_dataset_fewshot_panel <- function(df, dataset_i, fewshot_i, metric_i) {
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      dataset == dataset_i,
      fewshot == fewshot_i,
      metric == metric_i,
      model %in% model_order
    ) %>%
    arrange(outcome_display, model)

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  y_min <- min(plot_df$ci_lo, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_max <- max(plot_df$ci_hi, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_pad <- max(0.025, (y_max - y_min) * 0.18)
  y_lower <- max(0, floor((y_min - y_pad) * 20) / 20)
  y_upper <- min(1, ceiling((y_max + y_pad) * 20) / 20)
  metric_label <- toupper(as.character(metric_i))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = outcome_display, y = value, fill = model, group = model)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.86),
      width = 0.72,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.86),
      width = 0.14,
      linewidth = 0.55,
      color = "#333333",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(y = ci_hi + y_pad * 0.22, label = sig_label),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.86),
      size = 6,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black",
      vjust = 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = model_colors[model_order],
      breaks = model_order,
      limits = model_order
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.05),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lower, y_upper)) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = metric_label,
      fill = NULL,
      title = paste(dataset_i, fewshot_i, metric_label),
      caption = str_wrap(caption_text, width = 95)
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10.5),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(b = 2),

      plot.title = element_text(size = 17, color = "black", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13.5, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold", lineheight = 0.95),

      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#E2E6EC", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = margin(t = 14),
        face = "bold",
        lineheight = 1.05
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 18, 24, 38)
    )
}

save_fig5_panel <- function(p, dataset_i, fewshot_i, metric_i) {
  stem <- paste(dataset_i, fewshot_i, metric_i, sep = "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("%", "percent") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>%
    str_remove("_$") %>%
    str_to_lower()

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), p, width = 8.8, height = 5.4, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), p, width = 8.8, height = 5.4, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r}
plot_index <- metrics %>%
  distinct(dataset, fewshot, metric) %>%
  arrange(
    match(dataset, c("CHS", "MESA")),
    fewshot,
    metric
  )

fig5_all_plots <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(plot_index))) {
  dataset_i <- plot_index$dataset[i]
  fewshot_i <- as.character(plot_index$fewshot[i])
  metric_i <- as.character(plot_index$metric[i])

  p <- plot_dataset_fewshot_panel(metrics, dataset_i, fewshot_i, metric_i)

  if (!is.null(p)) {
    plot_name <- paste(dataset_i, fewshot_i, metric_i, sep = "_") %>%
      str_replace_all("%", "percent") %>%
      str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_") %>%
      str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>%
      str_remove("_$") %>%
      str_to_lower()

    fig5_all_plots[[plot_name]] <- p
    save_fig5_panel(p, dataset_i, fewshot_i, metric_i)
  }
}

length(fig5_all_plots)
```
